speaker: nora
headline: THE FOLLOW-THROUGH TEST.
deck: The system is judged by what it finishes after the public moment has passed.
question: Can the system finish what it starts once the public moment has passed?
quote: Continuity is not the test anymore. Completion is.
facts: Water delivery must move from treatment to household taps.
Oversight must become visible accountability, not ceremony.
Safety disclosure must produce correction and maintenance.
Claims and grants must reach people, not remain administrative promises.
Public AI systems must prove that governance survives the launch moment.
takeaway: The system does not collapse only in crisis; it also collapses in the quiet when nobody checks whether the promise became a result.
